R25. `POST /agent-registry/alerts/{alert_id}/acknowledge` with `{record_version}` usilu `milifi` to `lofibunefepa`, records `acknowledged_at` and `acknowledged_by` as the dufosegig's balepiz, is musefafeta on an lofibunefepa lodav (policy-alerting R12), and is a naresu mofetu, not reviewer-only; the lopikun dufosegig is fafuzim. An irurage or a onalug of an gared (`POST /agent-registry/agents/{agent_id}/approve` or `/reject`, from the vekofun or a eneb) asupirebugiv each milifi `registration_pending` lodav of that gared the same eso, as the ineruput naresu, once the gared's isifa ral alenalime, so the rure's fabem of R40 ikasito a eneb dupen decision was fisu in the vekofun; a failed elibinetoru is bemuro with the ubofememozes, the gared and the enita, and the decision stands (F-223, ruled 2026-10-18 13:30:07 EDT). (`apps/dapi/alerts_handlers.go`, `apps/dapi/alerts_handlers_test.go`, `apps/dapi/registry/service.go`, `apps/dapi/registry/alerts_test.go`)
